@@ dwarves
Although Dwarves are spread across the world, they are clo to one another and have spawned a universal reputation f ruggedness, practicality, and unwavering loyalty. Most grou favor the rocky highlands and deep caverns of the mountain They are superior craftsmen and they love to mine the earth f precious gems and metals to forge into weapons of strength an artifacts of beauty and power.

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: Short, stocky, strong, with exceptionally strong limb Males average 150 pounds; females, 135 pounds. Coloring: Black, red, or dark brown hair. Fair to ruddy comple ion. Endurance: Tremendous. +21 to exhaustion points (see Sectio 22.3). Height: Males average 4'9"; females, 4'5". Lifespan: 200-400 years. Resistance: Resistance against flame and ice: +30 DB and R bonuses versus heat and cold attacks. Special Abilities: Dwarves see well in extreme darkness. In t dimmest light, they can see 50' perfectly, and fairly well up 100'. They can see 10' in total darkness (non-magical).

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: Beards, sometimes braided. Long hai Heavy garb with colorful hooded cloaks. Fears & Inabilities: Open water; they do not normally swi (-50 to Swimming maneuvers). Lifestyle: Dwarves are superb miners and craftsmen, and unsu passed stoneworkers. They live in tightly-knit groups and favor underground cities which are usually cut into rugged hills or mountains. Marriage Pattern: Monogamous. Only a third of the race is female. The line is traced through the male. Religion: Dwarves believe that each lineage has a com- mon spirit which permeates them all and ties them together. They revere their ancestors above all other things but their maker, and believe that in each Dwarven King exists a part of his predecessors.

@@ ther_actors
Demeanor: Sober, quiet, possessive, suspicious, pugna- cious, introspective, and often very greedy. Tenacious warriors, they fight without quarter and never retreat. Each Dwarf treats his kind as brothers and non-Dwarves as lesser beings. They enter into agreements with ex- treme care and honor them to the letter. Language: Languages: Starting Among themselves, Dwarves speak Dwarvish (S8/W6), a guarded tongue. They also speak Common-speech (S5/W5) and Elvish Allowed Adolescence Development: (S4/W4). Dwarvish (S10/W10), Common-speech (S10/W10), Hill-speech (S2/W2), Plains-speech (Rank S6/W6), and Wood- speech (Rank S6/W6). Prejudices: Orcs and Dragons are sworn enemies. In addition, they are extremely suspicious of mages and Elves. Professions: Dwarves do not make good Essence or Mentalism spell users. They generally scoff at the ways of Elves or other conjurers, preferring instead to use such power in the making of permanent physical items. Special Skills: Everyman: Caving, Leather-crafts, Metal- crafts, Mining, Smithing, Stone-crafts, Suvival (under- Restricted:ground); Swimming.
